SELECT item_id, item_name, dance_class_name, deadline, expected_arrival_date, arrival_status, size_summary_str, created_at FROM item_demand
(dance_class_name = #{danceClassName} OR dance_class_name = 'GRADE_ALL')
AND (deadline IS NULL OR deadline = '' OR deadline >= DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'))
ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT enrollment_id, item_id, parent_name, quantity, created_at FROM item_demand_enrollment WHERE item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
